risk_note: RV2 settlement + migration (B2-18a; 08 BR-FUND-04 ④ as rewritten 2026-11-21, owner confirmed; orchestrator D10-2415 / D10-2425 / D10-2449). Sub-orders of the bill month that are not held, have no rights case and still have no union settlement data when generation starts are only counted: the bill-day job adds its platform count to the new column app.settle_bills.unsettled_count in the same UPDATE, transaction and bill row lock as error_count / held_count (0 when none, also for a platform whose crediting switch is off), registers no settle_missing difference ticket and does not count them in error_count; the supplement command registers none either and writes no bill counter. Candidates, batches, totals, postings and every amount computation are unchanged; amount mismatch still registers settle_amount_mismatch (B2-18). Migration 0154_settle-bills-unsettled-counts.sql: two SET LOCAL timeouts, one ALTER TABLE adding unsettled_count and amount_mismatch_count (nullable integers, no default, each with an inline named CHECK >= 0), one column-level GRANT UPDATE to couli_app; no backfill, existing rows keep NULL; amount_mismatch_count is only created here (B2-18 writes it). 13 frozen settlement tests follow the changed rule and one frozen db kit gets an import and a bare call (modify_existing, owner agreed 2026-11-21, D10-2425; records below). Implementation requirements taken over from the rule-test review (D10-2449: first-platform counter in the bill transaction, migration without data change, settle_period never written) were checked line by line in the money review; the companion rule tests are FU-B2-18A-SPEC-R2-GAPS, right after this merge. PDD / JD orders still cannot be credited (no settlement record write path, D10-2402): not solved here. Test machine on the rebased head ca655cb0bda7 (tree ef930305a89a): verify-sharded-summary green with scope fast+test:int+test:browser (verify:fast exit 0; test:int segments 1-6 and rest all exit 0, 2195 files / 19908 tests = int_files_total; --browser exit 0 incl. build-smoke), not_covered test:smoke and db:check — db:check itself was not run on the test machine; instead the LAN snapshot of the head was compared byte for byte with the committed db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts (equal, main control equal). The required CI checks are the full verification.
